title: fix(ui): align environment picker trailing controls
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes uneven right alignment of the environment picker's Unavailable message, selection checkmark, and add-device/cloud buttons.

## User Impact

The trailing text and icons share one right edge. Selection, filtering, and unavailable-state behavior stay the same.

## Why This Change Was Made

Hide empty selection slots after Unavailable messages, reuse the shared 14px checkmark size, and align the add button's icon with the row inset. Selectable rows retain their checkmark slot so labels stay stable when selected. CSS only; production delta: +3/-5 lines.

## Evidence

Real `/new` UI in isolated Chromium, using the existing synthetic Gateway fixture. Baseline: `9e28f32dd97`; candidate: this PR. Identical data, dark theme, and viewports.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: misaligned trailing controls](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c4527fd-3170-4275-82d1-d1123da1d19c) | ![After: aligned trailing controls](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93b3de94-1a1e-4d2d-8457-df60760b498e) |

| Mobile search, before | Mobile search, after |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: unavailable status inset](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb1e1f5c-c475-482a-9e7a-eb0f88248b9e) | ![After: unavailable status aligned](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/10ad94dc-5b55-483e-aaeb-bfcdcf28c58e) |

- Browser measurements at 1440×900, 1366×768, 768×1024, and 390×844: the spread between trailing right edges falls from **29px to 0px**. Search and no-results states verified. At narrow heights the list scrolls; the filtered mobile capture makes the hosted row visible.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/new-session/where-chip.test.ts ui/src/pages/new-session/cloud-target.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **28 passed**.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check ui/src/styles/new-session.css`: passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/stylelint --config config/stylelint.config.mjs ui/src/styles/new-session.css`: passed.
- Production-bundle browser regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/new-session-page.environment-metadata.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **2 passed**, including checked/unchecked row geometry and live eligibility/capacity updates.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

Loading skeletons and cloud configuration cards are unchanged; no live provider calls or Gateway changes were needed for this CSS fix.
